video.title: AI欧腐《等等...原来你也不是人？/Wait... You're Not Human Either?》
video.desc:
Finn, a century-old red fox who takes human form for fun, steals a stranger's heirloom ring—and accidentally breaks it. Unable to pay it back, he offers himself instead, and somehow ends up married to him. Finn believes his husband is an ordinary human, so he hides his fox ears and tail; Adrian, meanwhile, is secretly a black snake—also an immortal—and thinks Finn is human too. Two monsters, both hiding their true nature, learn how to be a human couple. Over decades, they secretly dye their hair white, paint on wrinkles, and dread facing their partner's death. Only after nearly two hundred years do they discover: the "mortal" each feared losing was just like them—and can stay by their side for a very, very long time.

Finn是一只活了一百年的红狐，闲来无事就化成人形玩耍。某天他偷了一个陌生人的祖传戒指——却不小心弄坏了，但他赔不起，索性直接把自己赔了出去，稀里糊涂地嫁给了对方。
Finn以为丈夫是普通人类，便把狐狸耳朵和尾巴藏得严严实实；而 Adrian 其实是一条黑蛇——同样长生不老——也以为 Finn 是人。两个妖怪，各自隐瞒真身，学着做一对人类夫妻。几十年间，他们偷偷把头发染白、在脸上画出皱纹，各自暗暗害怕着终有一天要送走伴侣。
直到将近两百年后，他们才发现：自己一直害怕失去的那个"凡人"，原来和自己一样——可以陪在身边很久、很久。
